name: MFA Boston Kids Studio Art Classes (Summer Studio Art Classes)
description_short: Full-day, in-person art classes at the Museum of Fine Arts Boston in summer, with groups for ages 5–7, 6–8, 8–10 and 9–11 and a new theme each week. Kids look at the museum's collection, then draw, paint, sculpt, make collages and print. The museum also runs weekend classes during the school year and classes during school vacation weeks.
special_needs_notes: The museum says its classes have more rules and expectations than other youth programs. They suit only students who can stay engaged in classroom-based art making. There is no active play or outdoor time.

warnings: The page covers all of the MFA's kids art classes: weekend classes during the school year, vacation-week classes and summer classes. This listing is about the summer program.
The page has no summer dates or prices. Its ticket table lists only Fall 2026 ('On sale now') and Winter 2027 ('On sale November 10'). Season year is left blank.
Members pay a lower rate ('member rate for kids and teen class tickets starts at the Friends and Family level'). This is a membership discount, not financial aid.
Summer registration closes at 12 pm on the Friday before each class starts.

Other programs on the page: preschool classes for ages 4–5 with an adult; drop-off weekend classes for ages 6–11 (10 weeks per term); February and April vacation-week classes, Tuesday–Friday, for ages 6–11, with up to 12 students per class.
